invariants: UsageMetrics MUST be Ref-backed and scoped to the active runtime Session
UsageMetrics MUST aggregate by Provider and Model without external telemetry
UsageMetrics MUST retain only a bounded recent Inference list

responsibilities: Record deterministic Inference UsageMetrics after successful Orchestrator execution
Provide aggregated Session totals to management Commands
prohibited: MUST NOT send telemetry outside the process
MUST NOT mutate metrics through module-level globals
MUST NOT record failed Provider attempts as successful Inference calls
